source: Actual browser screenshots of the running Ubuntu operator, captured through computer-use screenshot API
mode: stepped simulation; physics pauses between requests; separate from continuous reserved evaluation
request: Put the red box in the left tray
editing: Every captured screenshot retained in order at 8 fps, scaled and padded to a fixed video canvas. Irregular screenshot intervals and between-tool gaps are condensed. No title cards, fabricated model outputs or UI reconstruction. Playback is not real-time.
